title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
zh_title: OpenScientist：面向临床与生物医学发现的开源智能体AI协作科学家
summary: Nature Medicine 发表开源智能体 OpenScientist，可依据科学家提出的问题生成有数据依据、可验证的分析，并经领域专家在五个生物医学案例中评估。
key_points: 五个案例由领域专家评估，分析数分钟完成
生成血浆蛋白组生存模型，在隐藏评估队列中预测生存
多发性骨髓瘤假设在外部队列中得到验证
reason: 同行评审、开源，含隐藏队列与外部队列验证；契合科学发现智能体偏好，但仅五个案例
abstract: Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.
zh_abstract: 生物医学研究受限于分析日益庞大和复杂的数据集所需的时间和领域专业知识。在此，我们介绍 OpenScientist，这是一种开源的智能体（agentic）AI 协同科学家，旨在通过研究科学家定义的问题并生成可验证、以数据为依据的分析来弥补这一差距。领域专家在五个生物医学案例研究中对 OpenScientist 进行了评估，其在数分钟内完成了原本需要人类耗费数月时间和专业知识才能完成的分析。它准确量化了阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物的表现；生成了一个血浆蛋白质组生存模型，该模型在隐藏评估队列中可预测生存；提出了一种可重复的、将 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变相联系的机制；生成了多发性骨髓瘤假设，这些假设在外部队列中得到验证，而在随机对照中信号减弱；并且在一项盲法、预先设定的蛋白质组比较中，与独立的人工分析结果表现出一致性。这些结果支持将 OpenScientist 用于与人类专家协同辅助生物医学数据分析。为支持涉及敏感临床数据集的研究，OpenScientist 可在完全物理隔离（air-gapped）的环境中运行，并使用开源模型进行推理。OpenScientist 表明，开放、可审计的智能体 AI 能够通过检索文献、生成假设、执行分析以及从复杂数据集中产生见解，来支持真实世界的临床研究。

title: STBI: dataset of over 12000 brain CT scans for machine learning in traumatic brain injury

summary: 发布Shiraz-TBI数据集，含3602例患者、12,155次连续脑CT，附结构化标注、时间变量及部分多模态临床与功能结局。
key_points: 37.6万余张DICOM图像，另提供NIfTI格式
放射科医生标注出血亚型、中线移位等

reason: 大规模公开纵向影像数据集，附临床结局，属重要档
abstract: Publicly available traumatic brain injury (TBI) imaging datasets remain limited by the absence of longitudinal imaging, standardized annotations, and linked clinical outcomes. We developed and validated the Shiraz-TBI (STBI) dataset, a large-scale multimodal resource comprising 3602 patients, 12,155 serial non-contrast brain CT examinations, and 376,195 DICOM images, with all studies additionally available in NIfTI format. Radiologists generated structured annotations for intracranial hemorrhage subtypes, mass effect, midline shift, skull fractures, Marshall CT scores, and other imaging features, while temporal variables and time-to-surgery outcomes were derived. Internal validation by neurosurgeons demonstrated near-perfect inter-rater agreement (κ > 0.85 for most variables). A multimodal subset of 1259 patients includes demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and functional outcome data. By integrating patient-level longitudinal chronologically ordered serial neuroimaging with standardized annotations, temporal information, and prognostic outcomes, STBI provides a publicly available, machine learning-ready resource for imaging analysis, disease progression modeling, prognostic prediction, and clinical decision support in TBI.
zh_abstract: 公开可用的创伤性脑损伤（TBI）影像数据集仍受限于缺乏纵向影像、标准化标注以及关联的临床结局。我们开发并验证了 Shiraz-TBI（STBI）数据集，这是一个大规模多模态资源，包含 3602 名患者、12,155 次连续非增强脑部 CT 检查和 376,195 幅 DICOM 图像，所有检查另提供 NIfTI 格式。放射科医生对颅内出血亚型、占位效应、中线移位、颅骨骨折、Marshall CT 评分及其他影像特征进行了结构化标注，同时衍生出时间变量和手术时间结局。神经外科医生进行的内部验证显示评分者间一致性近乎完美（大多数变量 κ > 0.85）。一个包含 1259 名患者的多模态子集纳入了人口统计学、临床、实验室、治疗及功能结局数据。通过将患者层面按时间顺序排列的纵向连续神经影像与标准化标注、时间信息和预后结局相整合，STBI 为 TBI 的影像分析、疾病进展建模、预后预测和临床决策支持提供了一个公开可用、适用于机器学习的资源。

title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories

abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry (n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV (n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses supported distinct urate-inflammatory and systemic-vulnerability axes, although the C3 senescence-related genetic signal was nominal and requires replication. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: 需要能够将可规模化的临床表型与分子机制相联系的整合性框架，以解析疾病异质性。我们利用来自英国生物银行（UK Biobank，UKB；n = 10,599）、多中心中国 GoutRe 登记研究（n = 8617）和 MIMIC-IV（n = 2019）共 21,235 名参与者的常规数据，开发并在外部评估了一个可解释的痛风临床亚型框架。基于六个预先设定的常规实验室变量进行无监督学习，识别出三个亚型：C1，低负担状态，储备功能保留；C2，尿酸代谢-炎症状态，复发倾向最高，且心血管代谢及肝脏合并症负担更重；C3，以全身脆弱性和更高死亡率为特征的状态。在 UKB 中，考虑死亡竞争风险的复发分析显示，C2 相比 C1 的复发发生率更高（亚分布风险比 [sHR] 1.896，95% CI 1.710–2.101），而 C3 与 C1 无差异（sHR 0.994，95% CI 0.887–1.112）。一个包含六个变量的 CRT 模型在 UKB 中采用嵌套 10 折袋外评估重建了锁定的亚型标签，并在 GoutRe 和 MIMIC-IV 中不经重新训练进行外部应用。C1/C2/C3 的一对多 AUC 在 UKB 中分别为 0.965/0.945/0.980，在 GoutRe 中分别为 0.906/0.914/0.953，在 MIMIC-IV 中分别为 0.912/0.898/0.962。遗传学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析支持存在不同的尿酸-炎症轴和全身脆弱性轴，但 C3 与衰老相关的遗传信号仅为名义水平，尚需重复验证。常规实验室数据可以识别具有不同分子特征以及复发和死亡模式的痛风临床亚型；这些亚型能否指导临床管理仍需前瞻性评估。

title: Interpretable distance-resolved graph learning for cancer gene priority screening
zh_title: 可解释距离分辨图学习用于癌症基因优先级筛选
summary: 提出CGMap图学习框架，在生物分子网络中按距离分辨通道定位分散信号，筛选潜在癌症基因并提供可追溯的机制线索。
key_points: 距离分辨通道捕获多尺度拓扑信号

reason: 新方法有可解释性，但摘要未见实验验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Systematic screening for cancer genes (CGs) is still a central goal in precision oncology, yet integrating sparse and spatially dispersed oncogenic signals to identify testable candidates remains challenging. Here we present CGMap, an interpretable graph-learning framework that uses a width-oriented parallel architecture to prioritize potential CGs from biomolecular networks and trace mechanistic cues. By constructing distance-resolved channels, CGMap localizes spatially dispersed CG signals across multiple topological scales while avoiding representation homogenization. A global diffusion module quantifies gene cooperativity along pathway contexts and yields traceable virtual interactions that map predictions to potential regulatory hypotheses, providing intrinsic interpretability for model decisions. Across multiple biomolecular networks in a pan-cancer setting, CGMap analysed 12,022 genes, consistently outperformed existing methods while remaining computationally efficient and prioritized 70 reliable candidates, including those previously unannotated in established databases. Importantly, the prioritized candidates were associated with the suppression of tumour-related phenotypes, including reduced cell proliferation, migration and invasion, along with a shift of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related features toward a non-mesenchymal state, as supported by parallel loss-of-function assays across cancer and non-malignant cell lines.
zh_abstract: 系统性筛选癌症基因（CGs）仍是精准肿瘤学的核心目标，但整合稀疏且空间分散的致癌信号以识别可检验的候选基因仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出 CGMap，一种可解释的图学习框架，采用面向宽度的并行架构，从生物分子网络中对潜在癌症基因进行优先排序并追溯机制线索。通过构建距离解析通道，CGMap 在多个拓扑尺度上定位空间分散的癌症基因信号，同时避免表征同质化。全局扩散模块沿通路背景量化基因间的协同性，并产生可追溯的虚拟相互作用，将预测结果映射到潜在的调控假说，从而为模型决策提供内在可解释性。在泛癌设置下的多个生物分子网络中，CGMap 分析了 12,022 个基因，始终优于现有方法且计算效率较高，并优先筛选出 70 个可靠候选基因，其中包括在既有数据库中此前未被注释的基因。重要的是，经癌细胞系和非恶性细胞系的平行功能缺失实验支持，这些优先候选基因与肿瘤相关表型的抑制相关，包括细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭减少，同时上皮-间质转化（EMT）相关特征向非间质状态转变。

abstract: [The Lancet regional health. Europe] A novel artificial intelligence-based electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) model (AiTiA MI v2.00.00) for the early diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction (AMI) was developed using data from Korean patients. Its performance in a European population remains unknown. Patients presenting to the emergency department (ED) with suspected AMI were enrolled in two prospective European cohorts (APACE & APACE-Light; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT00470587). The primary outcome was AMI, centrally adjudicated according to the fourth Universal Definition of MI. The AI-ECG model was applied to 12-lead ECGs recorded at ED presentation. Its diagnostic performance for AMI was directly compared to that of the BASEL score, high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (hs-cTnT), the recalibrated HEART score (all at ED presentation), and integrated physician judgment at 90 min, with the last two only available in APACE. Predefined AI-ECG triage thresholds for early rule-out and rule-in of AMI were also evaluated. Among 12,630 patients with an available digital 12-lead ECG (5047 in APACE and 7583 in APACE-Light), adjudicated AMI was diagnosed in 19% (968/5047) and 18% (1386/7583) of patients, respectively. In patients with hs-cTnT at presentation (n = 5031 and n = 7565), the AI-ECG model showed good diagnostic performance for AMI with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.78 (95% CI: 0.77-0.80) and 0.84 (0.83-0.85) and an area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.56 (0.53-0.59) and 0.65 (0.62-0.67). Its discrimination was inferior to hs-cTnT (AUC 0.94 [0.93-0.95] and 0.93 [0.92-0.94]). The AI-ECG model provided some incremental diagnostic value when combined with hs-cTnT (AUC 0.95 [0.94-0.96] and 0.95 [0.94-0.95], p < 0.001). The predefined triage thresholds ruled out 14% (706/5031) and 19% (1437/7565) of patients, with a sensitivity for AMI of 97.6% (96.5-98.5) and 97.5% (96.6-98.3), respectively. AI-ECG showed high, but not very high, diagnostic accuracy for AMI. As a diagnosis of AMI is unlikely to be ruled out on ECG alone, combining AI-ECG with hs-cTnT may improve decision making in the ED, warranting prospective studies. abstract: Clinical history-taking and documentation are foundational competencies in undergraduate medical training, yet scalable and individualized training tools remain limited. Large language model (LLM)-based systems provide automated practice opportunities but often lack structured medical reasoning, closed-loop instructional design, and integration into formal curricula. As part of a curriculum reform initiative, we constructed a clinical case repository, developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated faculty Plan–Do–Check–Act (PDCA) training framework supported by dual chain-of-thought (CoT)-driven LLMs, and evaluated the reliability of AI-based scoring against faculty assessment. We then conducted a retrospective observational analysis of routinely collected educational performance data from 135 undergraduate medical students enrolled in one of three existing instructional configurations: traditional instruction, AI-assisted training, or AI + PDCA training. Educational outcomes were assessed using standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) assessments. The AI + PDCA configuration was associated with the highest OSCE performance in both history-taking and clinical documentation. Among the two AI-supported configurations, longitudinal mixed-effects modeling showed steeper learning trajectories in the AI + PDCA configuration than in the AI-assisted configuration. These findings suggest that integrating AI-derived learning analytics with faculty-guided instructional intervention may support a closed-loop educational model associated with favorable competency acquisition while maintaining human oversight. This framework offers a scalable approach for implementing trustworthy, competency-based AI-enhanced medical education in routine academic practice.

abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
zh_abstract: 在大规模无标注语料上训练的基础模型会产生涌现能力，即超出训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出 Bonbon，一种用于分子相互作用的基础模型，在约 3.2 万亿个配对蛋白质-配体序列 token 上训练。Bonbon 在单一表示空间中展现出三种处于不同分辨率层级的零样本涌现能力：功能层面（作用机制）、残基层面（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构位点区分）以及化学键层面（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力均可泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon 仅在蛋白质-配体序列上训练，没有任何任务特异性监督，也没有结构坐标。我们在从 42M 到 1.6B 参数的六种模型规模上进行了受控的缩放实验；尽管预训练损失平滑下降，所评估的每种能力在最大规模上，其连续指标均出现陡然跃升。这表明仅凭基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时出现。这里报告的能力是在 1:2,000 的参数与 token 比例下训练后出现的，以适应配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。同样的冻结表示在结合与亲和力预测上达到最先进水平，速度比共折叠（co-folding）方法快五个数量级。在涵盖七个蛋白家族、九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon 对从头设计化合物的剂量-反应命中率达 61.5%，产生了此前未报道可抑制这些蛋白的结构新颖分子，其中包括针对分布外靶点的分子。

abstract: Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no architecture is best on every variable, and which model wins changes from variable to variable. Across five ICU databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID, and UMM (University Medicine Mannheim), a German single-center ICU) we forecast 94 channels over a 24-hour horizon with a pool of 14 models, and combine them with weights fitted per variable. On test, the combination beats the best single model on all five databases by 6.1-11.0% mean squared error (mean 8.7%). The gain is concentrated where clinical data is thinnest: the sparsest third of channels improves by 11.9% and laboratory values by 7.5%, against 3.1% for the densest third. Rank-based harmonic weighting of the best five models per variable, with no fitted weights at all, recovers about four-fifths of the gain. Extending the pool afterwards with a per-channel gradient-boosted tree, ARIMA and ETS makes the tree the validation-selected best single model on all five databases; per-variable combination still improves on it by 2.9-5.9% (significant on four of five), while equal weighting of the same members does not. As on univariate benchmarks, learned combination beats simple averaging - but only once the weights are constrained. We also report which model to prefer when, and show that the ordering changes with database size.

abstract: [Journal of perinatal medicine] Naegele's calendar rule and an exact 280-day count are commonly treated as equivalent methods for estimating the due date (EDD), although their calendar arithmetic differs. We quantified this difference and evaluated whether generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems disclosed and accurately labeled the method used. A deterministic script calculated EDDs for every last menstrual period (LMP) date from January 1, 1812, through December 31, 2025, using Naegele's calendar rule and a fixed 280-day count. Five generative AI systems answered four prespecified LMP prompts, representing agreement and differences of 1, 2, and 3 days. Each prompt was submitted in three separate conversations, yielding 60 responses. Among 78,163 LMP dates, the methods produced identical EDDs in 34,609 cases (44.3 %) and different EDDs in 43,554 (55.7 %). Naegele's calendar rule produced dates 1 day later in 27.0 %, 2 days later in 21.0 %, and 3 days later in 7.7 %. The methods never agreed among 14,828 intervals containing February 29. Of 60 AI responses, 57 (95.0 %) included the exact 280-day date and 48 (80.0 %) stated a calculation method. Only 18 of 45 responses to divergent dates distinguished the algorithms. Twelve of 48 method-stating responses contained a method-label mismatch. Naegele's calendar rule and fixed 280-day counting are distinct algorithms. Their small numerical differences are unlikely to be clinically important, but they provide a deterministic test of computational transparency. Generative AI systems should disclose the calculation used, distinguish non-equivalent methods, and label them accurately.
zh_abstract: [Journal of perinatal medicine] 内格勒（Naegele）日历规则与精确的280天计数通常被视为估算预产期（EDD）的等效方法，尽管二者的日历运算并不相同。我们量化了这一差异，并评估生成式人工智能（AI）系统是否披露并准确标注所用方法。我们使用确定性脚本，按Naegele日历规则和固定280天计数，计算了1812年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间每个末次月经（LMP）日期的EDD。5个生成式AI系统回答了4个预先设定的LMP提示，分别代表结果一致以及相差1、2和3天的情形。每个提示在3次独立对话中提交，共产生60条回答。在78,163个LMP日期中，两种方法得出相同EDD的有34,609例（44.3%），EDD不同的有43,554例（55.7%）。Naegele日历规则得出的日期晚1天的占27.0%，晚2天的占21.0%，晚3天的占7.7%。在包含2月29日的14,828个时间区间中，两种方法从未一致。在60条AI回答中，57条（95.0%）包含精确280天的日期，48条（80.0%）说明了计算方法。针对结果不同的日期的45条回答中，仅18条区分了这两种算法。48条说明了方法的回答中有12条存在方法标注不符。Naegele日历规则与固定280天计数是不同的算法。二者微小的数值差异不太可能具有临床重要性，但它们为检验计算透明度提供了一个确定性测试。生成式AI系统应披露所用的计算方法，区分不等效的方法，并对其进行准确标注。

abstract: [Journal of computer assisted tomography] Multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) improves detection of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) but is limited by inter-reader variability. Artificial intelligence (AI) has been increasingly applied to prostate segmentation and lesion detection, with heterogeneous results. Concerns remain regarding generalizability, data set bias, and validation. This review summarizes recent evidence on AI-assisted prostate MRI interpretation, identifies knowledge gaps, and outlines directions for future research. A systematic literature search of PubMed and Google Scholar was performed for studies published between January 2023 and April 2025 evaluating AI-assisted interpretation of biparametric or multiparametric prostate MRI. Reference lists were manually reviewed. Eligible studies assessed diagnostic performance of AI alone or in combination with radiologists. Eighteen studies met inclusion criteria from 157 screened. Standalone AI systems achieved areas under the curve (AUCs) ranging from 0.77 to 0.91, with sensitivities of 65.4% to 96% and specificities of 77.6% to 91%, occasionally outperforming radiologists. Hybrid AI-radiologist models improved inter-reader agreement, reduced interpretation time by up to 50%, and enhanced detection accuracy for equivocal (PI-RADS 3) lesions. AI assistance particularly benefited junior and general radiologists, improving diagnostic performance, confidence, and reproducibility. In active surveillance cohorts, AI demonstrated greater accuracy than radiologists for detecting disease progression (AUC=0.86 vs. 0.69), although specificity limitations persisted. Overall, AI integration into prostate MRI workflows demonstrates substantial potential to improve detection efficiency and standardization. Broader clinical adoption will require large-scale, multicenter validation, harmonized imaging protocols, and rigorous outcome-based evaluation.

abstract: [Zhonghua nei ke za zhi] Conventional CT-guided percutaneous for thoracic lesions is primarily performed via freehand manipulation by the operator, and its accuracy is constrained by individual experience. Artificial intelligence optical navigation-assisted systems enable precise execution of preplanned puncture trajectories and visual guidance through high-precision spatial localization and robotic arm navigation, thereby markedly improving puncture success rate and procedural safety. To standardize and promote this technique and advance the precision diagnosis and treatment of thoracic tumors, this consensus was formulated by domestic experts organized jointly by the Ablation Expert Committee of the Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO), the Society of Tumor Ablation Therapy of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association, the Expert Group on Tumor Ablation Therapy of the Chinese Medical Doctors Association, the Tumor Ablation Committee of the Chinese College of Interventionalists,following in-depth discussions. abstract: [Pulmonary circulation] Computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is vital for diagnosing pulmonary hypertension (PH), especially thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH). However, manual image interpretation of CTPA often leads to misdiagnosis. This study aims to automatically segment the pulmonary artery from CTPA images and develop a deep learning model by fusing CTPA images with pulmonary artery segmentation results to distinguish pulmonary hypertension (PH vs. subjects without PH (no-PH)) and its PH subtype, CTEPH (CTEPH, other PH vs. no-PH). The study included 92 patients with CTEPH, 85 patients with other types of PH, and 140 no-PH. We completed the image preprocessing and segmentation of the pulmonary arterial tree of all the sample data. Based on four deep learning model classifiers-ResNet50, DenseNet, SENet, and Swin Transformer, we respectively developed four distinct network architectures: Single input channel for CTPA images, as well as early, middle, and late fusion strategies that combine CTPA images with their corresponding pulmonary vascular segmentation maps. abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Cirrhosis is a chronic liver disease, manifested by fibrosis and regenerative nodules. It can be classified clinically as compensated or decompensated. Accurate predictions of patients' transition from compensated to decompensated cirrhosis are important but difficult because of the multifactorial nature of disease progression, comorbid conditions, and patient heterogeneity. To effectively identify at-risk patients with cirrhosis and facilitate timely interventions across chronic diseases and patient populations, this study aimed to develop a deep learning-based method to estimate patient transition from compensated to decompensated cirrhosis. The proposed method seeks to provide superior predictive utilities and help physicians derive actionable clinical insights by modeling comorbidity relationships and symptom interdependencies that influence the progression of cirrhosis among patients. The proposed method was guided by clinical knowledge, considers patient demographics and medications, and leverages a graph structure to capture important comorbidity interplays. This method was augmented with post hoc interpretability to help clinicians understand its predictions for clinical decision-making and patient management. Using clinical data from 29,915 patients with cirrhosis, we evaluated the proposed method in comparison with 12 prevalent methods. The proposed method attained an average area under the curve (AUC) of 0.871 (SD 0.004), F-measure of 0.678 (SD 0.010), recall of 0.741 (SD 0.022), and precision of 0.663 (SD 0.005). It showed a 6.09% improvement in AUC and a 13.95% improvement in F-measure over the best-performing benchmark method. Supported by post hoc interpretation analyses, this method can provide physicians with interpretable visualizations of the underlying comorbidity and symptom dynamics to better support their decision-making and adoption. Empirical results underscore the value of demographic similarity, comorbidity graphs, and extended loss functions for identifying patients at higher risk of decompensation by capturing finer-grained information from essential patient features that tend to be overlooked by most existing methods. The proposed method not only supports physicians' clinical decision-making and patient management but can also enhance health care organizations' resource allocation efficiency and cost containment.

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] We developed and validated the pathogenesis models by hierarchical representation learning of interactomes connecting endometrial maturation, placentation, chorioamnionitis, and hemolysis, elevated liver enzyme, and low platelet (HELLP) syndrome. abstract: [JMIR formative research] Pregnancy-related weight gain is both physiologically complex and socially charged, and online discussions often combine clinical information with implicit emotional distress. Although automated sentiment analysis could support research on pregnancy-related discourse, model performance in this context remains inadequately characterized relative to expert human judgment. This study aimed to benchmark contemporary sentiment classification models on pregnancy-related weight discussions, with emphasis on agreement with expert consensus, interpretive ambiguity, task adaptation, and deployment across posts and comments. We curated 15,619 Reddit posts and comments using a large language model (LLM)-guided keyword expansion strategy and established an adjudicated consensus reference set of 200 posts. We evaluated 10 models on a fixed held-out test set (N=150) using aligned text inputs, weighted performance metrics, and 1000-resample bootstrap CIs. RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers Approach) and BERTweet (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers for Tweets) were additionally evaluated in a 5-fold fine-tuning sensitivity analysis. Gemini-3-Flash (Google DeepMind [Google LLC]) and Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT)-OSS (OpenAI) were then applied to 400 unlabeled posts and 15,019 comments with intermodel agreement assessment. To expand expert-labeled coverage, a separate 106-post annotation extension was used for secondary evaluation of the 2 models carried forward to post-level corpus inference, and cross-source recoverability of the API-derived retrieval was assessed using Arctic Shift (Arthur Heitmann). The 2 primary experts (FAK and BMW) achieved 59.0% preadjudication agreement (Cohen κ=0.344). In the fixed held-out comparison, Gemini-3-Flash had the numerically highest weighted F1-score of 0.662 (κ=0.478), followed by GPT-OSS (F1-score=0.645; κ=0.436), with overlapping CIs across leading models. Under the harmonized direct-argmax decision rule with minimally processed text, BERTweet achieved an F1-score of 0.623 (κ=0.369), and RoBERTa achieved an F1-score of 0.605 (κ=0.339). In the separate fine-tuning sensitivity analysis, the mean cross-validated F1-score was 0.708 (SD 0.087) for RoBERTa and 0.616 (SD 0.079) for BERTweet. Among Gemini-3-Flash errors, 55.8% (29/52) occurred in posts on which the 2 primary experts disagreed. In the 106-post annotation extension, primary-expert agreement was 64.

abstract: Single-cell transcriptome sequencing has been widely applied across the life sciences. It enables accurate and robust identification of cell types in heterogeneous biological tissues through unsupervised clustering, shallow learning, and deep learning. While deep learning does not outperform shallow learning in classification performance, it streamlines cell type identification by eliminating cumbersome preprocessing procedures. However, the availability of training datasets with comprehensive cell type annotations is always limited, so new datasets inevitably contain cell populations that are not pre-defined in the training data. To address this limitation, we integrated unsupervised clustering with transformer-based models to identify cell populations unrecognized by classical methods. Specifically, we developed the Nankai GeneRank Classifier by fine-tuning the pre-trained Geneformer-V1 model, and then clustered cells based on its softmax-normalized class probability matrix (SCPM). Applied to a public colorectal cancer dataset, the new method, named SCPM-based clustering, resolved cell populations that cannot be unambiguously identified by classical methods alone and led to the discovery of novel candidate markers of colorectal cancer stem cells, demonstrating its utility.

abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) generates substantial transcript signal outside segmented cell bodies, which is generally discarded by analysis tools. This is especially problematic for brain ST data, as neuronal mRNAs can be localized far from somata - in axons, dendrites, and synaptic compartments - and up to half of the transcripts in ST data may lie outside cell bodies. Here, we present SCOUBI, a computational framework that identifies axon-dendrite interfaces from extrasomatic RNA in ST data, revealing a hitherto overlooked layer of molecular function in neural tissues. It first partitions extrasomatic space into axon- and dendrite-enriched compartments based on known marker genes, using a neural network trained to maximize marker specificity and inter-compartment communication signals. It then defines interfaces as loci where predicted axonal and dendritic compartments converge and exhibit ligand-receptor colocalization. Applied to mouse brain, SCOUBI creates maps of axonal and dendritic compartments and their interfaces that align with known spatial patterns of neurite and synaptic distribution. It identifies transcriptomic differences between interfaces and the surrounding extrasomatic space, revealing region-specific signatures of neuronal signaling and synaptic plasticity. By comparing interface transcript enrichment with local somatic expression, SCOUBI identifies genes that preferentially localize at sites of intercellular communication rather than simply reflecting nearby cell bodies. SCOUBI reveals interface-associated transcripts beyond established synaptic genes, with molecular signatures reproducible across independent samples and imaging platforms. In summary, SCOUBI transforms a substantial and often-discarded aspect of ST data into an interpretable readout of subcellular organization and neural signaling.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）会产生大量位于已分割细胞体之外的转录本信号，而分析工具通常会将其舍弃。这对脑部 ST 数据尤其成问题，因为神经元 mRNA 可定位于远离胞体的位置——轴突、树突和突触区室——ST 数据中多达一半的转录本可能位于细胞体之外。在此，我们提出 SCOUBI，这是一个根据 ST 数据中的胞外体（extrasomatic）RNA 识别轴突-树突界面的计算框架，揭示了神经组织中此前被忽视的一层分子功能。它首先基于已知标志基因，利用一个以最大化标志物特异性和区室间通信信号为目标训练的神经网络，将胞体外空间划分为富含轴突和富含树突的区室；随后将界面定义为预测的轴突区室与树突区室汇聚且表现出配体-受体共定位的位点。应用于小鼠脑时，SCOUBI 生成的轴突和树突区室及其界面图谱与已知的神经突和突触分布空间模式一致。它识别出界面与周围胞体外空间之间的转录组差异，揭示了神经元信号传导和突触可塑性的区域特异性特征。通过比较界面转录本富集与局部胞体表达，SCOUBI 识别出优先定位于细胞间通信位点、而非仅仅反映邻近细胞体的基因。SCOUBI 揭示了已知突触基因之外的界面相关转录本，其分子特征在独立样本和成像平台间均可重复。总之，SCOUBI 将 ST 数据中大量且常被舍弃的部分转化为可解释的亚细胞组织和神经信号传导读数。

title: Know Thy Neighbour: Benchmarking Protein Language Model Embedding-Based Annotation Reveals Anisotropy Substantially Impacts Retrieval
zh_title: 蛋白语言模型嵌入注释基准：各向异性显著影响检索
summary: 对12个蛋白语言模型嵌入用于远缘同源检索进行基准测试，并与MMseqs2、Foldseek比较，发现各向异性影响检索。
key_points: 在Swiss-Prot和SCOPe数据集上评测
固定1%假阳性率阈值
未经检索训练的pLM最多召回15%远缘同源
reason: 规范基准评测有新见解，预印本
abstract: Functional annotation using protein language models (`pLMs') usually proceeds by transferring the function of a query's nearest neighbour in a reference database. A major drawback is that embedding-based annotation transfer has no null model, i.e. no accepted way to set a cosine-similarity threshold to control false positives. This contrasts with traditional bioinformatics methods, including sequence- and structure-based alignment tools, which rank hits with E-values derived from explicit null models. Here, we benchmark final-layer, mean-pooled embeddings from twelve models against MMseqs2 and Foldseek for remote-homology retrieval on curated datasets based on Swiss-Prot and SCOPe, fixing per-model thresholds at a 1% false-positive rate and probing the score with a ladder of synthetic decoys. On Swiss-Prot, pLMs without retrieval training recover at most 15% of remote homologs at this operating point, against 85% for MMseqs2, and for the ESM-2 and ESM-C families shuffled decoys have higher cosine similarities to their nearest database hits than real remote homologs do. These two pLM families exhibit extreme anisotropy, using fewer than 15 effective dimensions out of 640-2560, and low effective dimensionality is strongly associated with poor performance across models. Applying ZCA whitening, fit on the reference database, to the embeddings sharply raises threshold-free Top-1 superfamily retrieval, e.g. for ESM-2 650M from 59% to 88% on SCOPe, and generally improves remote homology sensitivity at a fixed false-positive rate. As correcting embedding anisotropy requires only the reference database and is compute cheap, it should be considered and tested for any pLM embedding-based annotation task.
zh_abstract: 使用蛋白质语言模型（pLM）进行功能注释通常是将查询序列在参考数据库中最近邻的功能进行转移。一个主要缺陷是，基于嵌入的注释转移没有零模型，即没有公认的方法来设定余弦相似度阈值以控制假阳性。这与传统生物信息学方法（包括基于序列和结构的比对工具）形成对比，后者利用由明确零模型推导的E值对匹配结果排序。在此，我们在基于Swiss-Prot和SCOPe整理的数据集上，以MMseqs2和Foldseek为对照，对十二个模型的末层、均值池化嵌入进行远缘同源检索的基准测试，将各模型的阈值固定在1%假阳性率，并用一系列梯度化的合成诱饵探查该得分。在Swiss-Prot上，未经检索训练的pLM在该工作点最多仅能找回15%的远缘同源序列，而MMseqs2为85%；对于ESM-2和ESM-C系列，打乱序列的诱饵与其数据库中最近匹配的余弦相似度高于真实远缘同源序列。这两个pLM系列表现出极端的各向异性，在640–2560维中使用的有效维度不足15个，并且低有效维度与各模型的不良表现密切相关。对嵌入应用基于参考数据库拟合的ZCA白化，可显著提高不依赖阈值的Top-1超家族检索表现，例如ESM-2 650M在SCOPe上从59%提高到88%，并且总体上改善了固定假阳性率下的远缘同源灵敏度。由于校正嵌入各向异性只需要参考数据库且计算成本低，对于任何基于pLM嵌入的注释任务，都应考虑并测试这一方法。

title: An apicomplexan-specific foundation model improves prediction of regulatory genomic signals in Plasmodium falciparum
zh_title: 顶复门特异基础模型改进恶性疟原虫调控基因组信号预测
summary: 在76种顶复门生物455个基因组上预训练GPN，并微调预测恶性疟原虫表观基因组特征，检验小基因组预训练的价值。
key_points: 掩码核苷酸重建预训练
预测TF结合、染色质可及性等
在留出染色体上评估
reason: 领域基础模型预印本，有新意但证据有限
abstract: Genomic foundation models learn transferable sequence representations through self-supervision, yet their practical value is contested. In data-rich mammalian genomes, task-specific models trained from scratch can match or exceed pretrained models on many regulatory prediction tasks. Whether self-supervised pretraining provides an advantage in small, data-sparse genomes has not been directly tested. We address this in the compact, 23Mbp, A/T-rich genome of the malaria parasite, Plasmodium falciparum. We trained a Genomic Pretrained Network (GPN) via masked-nucleotide reconstruction on 455 genome assemblies spanning 76 apicomplexan species. We then fine-tuned the model to predict a variety of epigenomic features in a held-out chromosome, including transcription factor binding sites, chromatin-accessibility, histone modifications, and 10 chromatin states. Pretraining followed by fine tuning improved prediction of most features, with most of the benefit concentrated on datasets with relatively little labeled data (fewer than 3,000 training examples). In contrast, a human-pretrained model transferred poorly, indicating that phylogenetically relevant pretraining, not foundation-model status alone, drives beneficial performance. Self-supervised pretraining on clade-specific assemblies is thus a practical route to data-efficient regulatory modeling in small genomes where training data is scarce.

title: YOLO11m-Based Artificial Intelligence Versus Orthopaedic Physician Panels for Arthroscopy-Referenced Three-Category MRI Classification of the Posterosuperior Rotator Cuff: A Multi-Reader Diagnostic Accuracy Study.
zh_title: YOLO11m模型与骨科医师组对肩袖MRI三分类的比较
summary: 单中心回顾性研究，以关节镜为参照，比较YOLO11m模型与不同经验医师组对冈上/冈下肌肩袖MRI三分类，AI总体准确率0.841。
key_points: 开发集300例，读片队列258例
12名盲法医师分四个三人组
reason: 关节镜参照、多读者对照，但单中心回顾性，设计规范
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) may support rotator cuff MRI interpretation; however, its performance relative to clinicians at different experience levels remains uncertain. We compared a locked YOLO11m-based model with prespecified orthopaedic physician panels using arthroscopy as the reference standard. Methods: This retrospective single-centre study included a separate 300-patient model-development dataset and an arthroscopy-referenced reader cohort of 258 patients (60 intact cuffs, 86 partial-thickness tears, and 112 full-thickness tears). Twelve blinded physicians were assigned to four three-reader experience panels, and panel diagnoses were defined by a two-of-three majority. Paired accuracy comparisons used exact McNemar tests with Holm adjustment. Results: AI achieved 0.841 overall accuracy (95% CI, 0.792-0.881). The senior-specialist panel had numerically higher accuracy (0.911), but the difference from AI was not statistically significant after adjustment (Holm p = 0.060); the junior-specialist panel also did not differ from AI (0.822; Holm p = 0.649). AI showed higher paired accuracy than the senior-resident (0.729; Holm p = 0.005) and junior-resident panels (0.671; Holm p < 0.001). Partial-thickness tears had the lowest AI sensitivity (0.709). Conclusions: In this restricted-cine, three-category benchmark, AI outperformed both resident panels, whereas neither specialist panel comparison reached the adjusted significance threshold. These findings do not establish equivalence to specialists or benefit from AI-assisted reading.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】人工智能（AI）可能有助于肩袖MRI的判读；然而，其相对于不同经验水平临床医生的表现仍不确定。我们以关节镜检查作为参考标准，将一个锁定的基于YOLO11m的模型与预先设定的骨科医师小组进行了比较。【方法】这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了一个独立的300例患者的模型开发数据集，以及一个以关节镜为参照的258例患者的阅片者队列（60例肩袖完整、86例部分厚度撕裂、112例全层撕裂）。12名盲法医师被分配到四个由三名阅片者组成的经验水平小组，小组诊断以三人中两人一致的多数意见确定。配对准确率比较采用精确McNemar检验并进行Holm校正。【结果】AI的总体准确率为0.841（95% CI，0.792-0.881）。资深专科医师小组的准确率在数值上更高（0.911），但校正后与AI的差异无统计学意义（Holm p = 0.060）；初级专科医师小组与AI亦无差异（0.822；Holm p = 0.649）。AI的配对准确率高于高年资住院医师小组（0.729；Holm p = 0.005）和低年资住院医师小组（0.671；Holm p < 0.001）。部分厚度撕裂的AI敏感性最低（0.709）。【结论】在这一受限电影序列、三分类的基准测试中，AI的表现优于两个住院医师小组，而与两个专科医师小组的比较均未达到校正后的显著性阈值。这些发现并不能证明AI与专科医师等效，也不能证明AI辅助阅片有益。

title: Agentic induction of common data elements and information extraction from sarcoma case report abstracts
zh_title: 智能体从肉瘤病例摘要归纳通用数据元素并抽取信息
summary: LLM智能体从24,588篇PubMed摘要中提出候选通用数据元素，整合后保留53个，并做带证据链接的抽取，人工评审显示正确性仍有限。
key_points: 72,909个候选整合为1,570个CDE
保留53个，专家认可正确性56.6%
抽样100篇，非空答案一致率94.9%
reason: 新颖智能体方法有人工评估，但仅摘要且正确性有限
abstract: Common data elements (CDEs) support clinical data comparability but are usually defined manually. We investigated whether large language model agents could derive a CDE schema from sarcoma case report abstracts and apply it at scale. An agent proposed 72,909 candidate CDEs from 24,588 PubMed abstracts; agentic consolidation yielded 1,570 CDEs. We retained 53 supported by at least 50 abstracts and attempted evidence-linked extraction across the corpus. Processing succeeded for all retained CDEs in 79.2% of abstracts, including responses indicating non-mention. Two human reviewers approved 83.0% of retained CDEs for relevance, 67.9% for clarity, and 56.6% for correctness. In 100 sampled abstracts, exact agreement with the value extracted by the LLM was 94.9% among 1,116 pairs with a non-empty answer (abstract-level bootstrap 95% CI, 93.0-96.4%). Errors concentrated in anatomical and temporal fields. These findings support agent-assisted schema drafting followed by expert curation before large-scale extraction.
zh_abstract: 通用数据元素（CDE）有助于临床数据的可比性，但通常需手工定义。我们研究了大语言模型智能体能否从肉瘤病例报告摘要中推导出CDE模式并大规模应用。一个智能体从24,588篇PubMed摘要中提出了72,909个候选CDE；经智能体整合后得到1,570个CDE。我们保留了至少有50篇摘要支持的53个CDE，并尝试在整个语料库中进行带证据链接的提取。在79.2%的摘要中，所有保留的CDE均处理成功，包括表示未提及的回答。两名人工评审者认定保留的CDE中，83.0%相关性合格，67.9%清晰度合格，56.6%正确性合格。在随机抽取的100篇摘要中，对于1,116个答案非空的配对，与LLM所提取值的完全一致率为94.9%（以摘要为单位的bootstrap 95% CI，93.0–96.4%）。错误集中在解剖部位和时间相关字段。这些发现支持先由智能体辅助起草模式，再经专家审定，然后进行大规模提取。

title: Future-Information Leakage in 30-Day Readmission Prediction: An Empirical Audit and a Calibrated Electronic Health Record Model in Medicare-Insured Adults
zh_title: 30天再入院预测中的未来信息泄漏：实证审计与校准模型
summary: 基于MIMIC-IV的23.7万例医保成人入院数据，审计发现某历史特征使用了未来住院信息造成泄漏，并构建了校准的再入院预测模型。
key_points: 回顾性研究，236,906例入院、87,750名患者
一项“前180天住院时长趋势”特征含后续入院信息
剔除泄漏特征及两个衍生项后测试AUC下降
reason: 回顾性、内部验证，但样本大且揭示方法学泄漏问题
abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a calibrated discharge model of 30-day within-system readmission in Medicare-insured adults, and to quantify how a future-information leak and outcome artifacts distorted performance, timing, and subgroup conclusions. Materials and Methods: Retrospective study of 236,906 Medicare-insured MIMIC-IV v3.1 admissions (87,750 patients; prevalence 21.4%). Predictors were audited for discharge-time availability; history features were tested for future information and recomputed from raw timestamps. A consensus gradient-boosted (XGBoost) model was selected inside patient-grouped folds; CIs used patient-cluster bootstrap. Results: A feature documented as a prior 180-day length-of-stay trend used each patient's whole record, including later admissions; removing it and two derived terms lowered test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from 0.774 to 0.706. The corrected procedure reached an out-of-fold AUROC of 0.7057 (95% CI 0.7016 to 0.7102; primary); the 44-feature model scored 0.7056 on the historically exposed test partition (calibration slope 0.99), above reconstructed LACE and HOSPITAL (both P<.001). A day-1 discrimination peak largely reflected 2,368 probable administrative continuations within 1 hour of discharge; merging these into the preceding stay gave test AUROC 0.698 (0.702 after refitting). The White minus Black AUROC difference was 0.003 (95% CI -0.018 to 0.024); specificity was lower for Black patients (0.61 vs 0.69). Discussion: Documentation audits and patient-grouped validation missed a leak that inflated discrimination and created spurious subgroup and calendar-period differences; simple empirical checks found it. Conclusion: Empirical leakage checks should accompany availability audits. The corrected model is calibrated, moderately discriminating, and needs external validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并内部验证一个经校准的、针对参加医疗保险（Medicare）成人患者的出院时 30 天系统内再入院预测模型，并量化未来信息泄漏和结局伪影如何扭曲模型性能、时间趋势及亚组结论。【材料与方法】对 MIMIC-IV v3.1 中 236,906 次参加 Medicare 的入院记录（87,750 名患者；患病率 21.4%）进行回顾性研究。对预测变量审核其在出院时是否可获得；对病史特征检验是否含有未来信息，并根据原始时间戳重新计算。在按患者分组的折内选择共识梯度提升（XGBoost）模型；置信区间采用患者聚类自助法（bootstrap）。【结果】一个被记录为既往 180 天住院时长趋势的特征使用了每位患者的整份病历，包括之后的入院记录；去除该特征及两个衍生项后，测试集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）由 0.774 降至 0.706。校正后的流程获得折外 AUROC 为 0.7057（95% CI 0.7016 至 0.7102；主要结果）；44 个特征的模型在曾暴露过的历史测试分区上得分为 0.7056（校准斜率 0.99），高于重建的 LACE 和 HOSPITAL 评分（均 P<.001）。第 1 天出现的区分度峰值主要反映了出院后 1 小时内 2,368 次可能属于行政性延续的入院；将这些记录合并入前一次住院后，测试集 AUROC 为 0.698（重新拟合后为 0.702）。白人与黑人的 AUROC 差值为 0.003（95% CI -0.018 至 0.024）；黑人患者的特异度较低（0.61 对 0.69）。【讨论】文档审核和按患者分组的验证都未能发现这一夸大区分度的泄漏，该泄漏还造成了虚假的亚组及日历时期差异；简单的经验性检查则发现了它。【结论】除可获得性审核外，还应进行经验性泄漏检查。校正后的模型经过校准，区分度中等，在临床使用前需要外部验证。

title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
zh_title: TotalSegmentator主动脉报告：CT上11个标准位点的自动测径
summary: 开源工具基于TotalSegmentator分割，在CT上自动测量主动脉11个标准位点直径；单中心回顾性评估239例CTA，以放射科医师校正结果为参考。
key_points: 开源工具，按指南定义11个位点
单中心回顾性，239例CTA/230名患者
以MAE、偏差及>2mm差异评估一致性
reason: 开源实用工具，但单中心回顾性小样本，属值得一看档
abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fully automated, open-source tool that measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks from the aortic annulus to the bifurcation on any CT image, following current guideline recommendations. Materials and Methods: This retrospective single-center study included 239 arterial phase CT angiography examinations of 230 patients (median age, 65 years [range, 18-99 years]; 163 men) performed between April 2025 and October 2026 (209 electrocardiographically [ECG] gated). The tool locates landmarks from TotalSegmentator segmentations of aortic branches and vertebrae and measures the maximum diameter at each. A senior radiologist reviewed and, where needed, corrected the automated measurements to create the reference standard. Agreement was assessed with mean absolute error (MAE), bias, and differences greater than 2 mm. Results: Across all landmarks, MAE was 1.06 mm (95% CI: 0.91, 1.22), and 86.6% (95% CI: 84.4, 88.5) of differences were 2 mm or less. The tool measured slightly larger diameters (bias, 0.45 mm [95% CI: 0.34, 0.57]). The sinuses of Valsalva had the largest MAE (2.17 mm [95% CI: 1.59, 2.86]). For 1.2% of landmarks, the automatic measurement failed. Examination-level MAE did not differ significantly by pathology, atherosclerosis grade (P=.95), or ECG gating (P=.14). Examinations with mural thrombus more often had an MAE greater than 2 mm (50% [95% CI: 31, 69] vs 20%; P=.03). Conclusion: The tool measured aortic diameters at 11 landmarks along the entire aorta with an MAE of about 1 mm, below published interreader variability. Agreement was lower at the aortic root and with mural thrombus. Code availability: The tool is open source and freely available at https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator.

title: MamaReason: Unfinished Reasoning and Answer Recovery in Clinical Language Models
zh_title: MamaReason：临床语言模型中未完成推理与答案恢复
summary: 在母婴健康基准MamaBench的217个配对病例上，研究临床语言模型未完成推理中已出现诊断、续写可恢复答案的现象。
key_points: 基于Gemma 4 31B改造
RL失败案例94例中75例含明确诊断
续写与该诊断在67/75例一致
reason: 新颖的预印本分析，规模有限且无外部验证
abstract: Answer continuation often returns a diagnosis already stated in unfinished clinical reasoning. We study this behavior in MamaReason, adapted from dense Gemma 4 31B, on MamaBench's 217 paired maternal and child-health presentations. An explicit-commitment extractor identifies a diagnosis in 75 of 94 failed RL first passes and 75 of 93 failed SFT first passes. The continuation matches that diagnosis in 67/75 RL cases and 58/75 SFT cases, using diagnosis strings alone. Reading these commitments without additional generation recovers 30 of the 40 RL pairs restored by continuation under the archived correctness labels. Recurrence controls distinguish routine mentions from repeated answer selection. An offline second-commitment trigger measures the tradeoff between earlier readout and paired accuracy. The resulting decomposition separates diagnostic content already present in a trace, completion of an accepted answer, and paired diagnostic correctness. For clinical language-model evaluation, these are distinct outcomes that become visible when the same reasoning trace is examined through multiple readouts.

title: Explanations that Transfer: Interpreting Medical Retrieval with Sparse AutoEncoders
zh_title: 用稀疏自编码器解释可迁移的医学检索
summary: 将稀疏自编码器用于医学信息检索，把稠密嵌入转为可解释表示，并结合重构与InfoNCE对比损失，在六个医学检索数据集上评估。
key_points: 重构目标结合InfoNCE对比损失保留相关性
评估三种嵌入模型、六个医学检索数据集

abstract: Medical AI systems that answer users' queries rely on retrieving medical knowledge from large document collections. In this context, finetuning general models on medical datasets can improve retrieval relevance. Yet the dense embeddings underlying modern retrieval systems remain largely opaque, making it difficult to understand the mechanics behind their results. Moreover, adapting to a specific medical dataset risks losing transferability to new clinical corpora. In this work, we tackle these issues by applying Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to medical information retrieval, transforming dense text embeddings into semantically interpretable representations. To do so, our model combines a reconstruction objective with an InfoNCE contrastive loss that directly preserves query-document relevance. We evaluate three embedding models across six medical retrieval datasets, both in-domain and out-of-domain. Trained on a medical corpus, our sparse codes improve in-domain retrieval over the original embeddings, and lose less out-of-domain performance than their dense counterparts, especially when the target corpus is distant from the training one. Importantly, our experiments show that the method yields interpretable features whose semantic content can be inferred from the queries and documents that activate them most strongly. The interpretation of these features sheds light on why a particular document was retrieved, and transfers beyond the training distribution.

abstract: We report a negative result in next-day clinical assessment forecasting: the evaluated models show no consistent advantage over strong persistence-based baselines. Clinicians can view the previous day's questionnaire answers, a plausible source of documentation persistence. Predicting 45 items on 29,715 ICU day-pairs with patient-disjoint splits, a physiology-informed gated model improves item-macro-F1 over a one-line clinical rule by +0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031], while losing accuracy. No macro-F1 advantage is established when the physiology window ends at the previous form's reference time (+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]), or when scoring excludes the 68.5% of cells derived from parent answers; combining both changes yields a small disadvantage. Four checkpoints across three families underperform persistence, and a fine-tuned one differs from it on only two cells. A categorical read-out raises changed-cell accuracy eightfold, but a state-only read-out scores higher overall than forecast-only decoding and matches a transition matrix. This negative result highlights how the documentation process, input cutoff, observation mask and decoding rule shape conclusions about forecasting recorded assessments.
zh_abstract: 我们报告了次日临床评估预测中的一项阴性结果：所评估的模型相较于强大的基于持续性（persistence）的基线没有一致的优势。临床医生可以查看前一天的问卷答案，这是文书记录持续性的一个合理来源。在29,715个ICU日对上预测45个条目，采用患者互不重叠的数据划分，一个融合生理信息的门控模型相比一行临床规则将条目宏平均F1提高了+0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031]，但准确率下降。当生理窗口在前一份表单的参考时间结束时（+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]），或当评分排除源自父级答案的68.5%单元格时，均未确立宏平均F1优势；二者同时改变则产生小幅劣势。三个模型家族的四个检查点表现均不如持续性基线，且一个经微调的模型与其仅在两个单元格上存在差异。类别型读出使发生变化的单元格的准确率提高八倍，但仅状态读出的总体得分高于仅预测解码，并与转移矩阵相当。这一阴性结果凸显了文书记录过程、输入截止时间、观测掩码和解码规则如何影响关于预测已记录评估的结论。

title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
zh_title: 可解释权重空间编程：构建透明Transformer与脑编码模型
summary: 提出iWSP，由LLM智能体通过代码直接编写权重和特征、无需反向传播，构建可解释模型并用于脑活动编码。
key_points: LLM智能体以代码手工编程权重
无需梯度训练，模拟科学家工作流
应用于脑编码模型，经LLM审核可解释性
reason: 智能体用于科学发现的新方法预印本，摘要证据有限
abstract: Neural networks are powerful predictors, yet their opacity limits their usefulness in science, where the goal is explanation rather than mere prediction. In neuroscience, for example, deep encoding models accurately predict brain activity in response to natural stimuli, but struggle to reveal which stimulus features drive those predictions. Here we introduce interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), a method in which an LLM agent iteratively builds interpretable models by explicitly programming their weights and features in code, without gradient-based training (backpropagation). Without backpropagation to tune parameters, the agent must draw on its prior knowledge and reason over previous trials to hypothesize, hand-craft, and refine human-interpretable computations mirroring the workflow of a human scientist. LLM audits confirm the interpretability of the hand-crafted models. We first validate iWSP by tasking it with constructing transformers for canonical benchmarks such as arithmetic and sentiment classification, finding that LLM agents can successfully craft compact, accurate networks directly. Next, we apply iWSP to build neural encoding models across vision, language, and audition. In the visual cortex, iWSP outpredicts existing interpretable baselines, uncovers distinct computations across early/higher visual areas, and generalizes to unseen data. In language fMRI, iWSP surfaces a confound in the data and in auditory ECoG, it systematically discovers interpretable acoustic features that predict neural activity. Together, these results establish iWSP as a general paradigm for aligning high predictive performance with human-interpretable scientific discovery.

abstract: [African journal of reproductive health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping global healthcare, offering unprecedented opportunities to strengthen diagnostics, clinical decision making, population health surveillance, and health system efficiency. Its promise is particularly significant for low and middle income countries, where AI enabled tools can help bridge gaps in workforce capacity, disease monitoring, and access to specialized care. Yet these advances carry profound risks. Algorithmic bias, opaque decision pathways, data governance failures, and widening digital inequities threaten to undermine trust and exacerbate existing disparities. Without robust ethical stewardship, AI may amplify structural vulnerabilities rather than alleviate them. This editorial examines AI's dual trajectory in global health-its transformative potential and emerging hazards-and argues for a coordinated governance framework grounded in transparency, accountability, equity, and human rights. As nations accelerate digital adoption, ethical leadership must become a central pillar of global health strategy to ensure AI serves collective benefit rather than drives unintended harm.

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering gynecologic and obstetric imaging, risk prediction, decision support, robotic surgery, remote monitoring, and patient communication. An estimated 260,000 maternal deaths occurred worldwide in 2023, and in England obstetric claims account for 11% of clinical negligence claims but 55% of their value. AI errors, bias, or opacity in this specialty therefore carry major clinical and legal consequences. Objective: To synthesize the principal medico-legal and bioethical challenges associated with AI in gynecology and obstetrics and to propose a lifecycle governance framework for responsible clinical adoption. Methods: A narrative review with thematic synthesis was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched for records published from January 2020 to August 2026, supplemented by citation chaining and official legal databases. Two reviewers screened 131 records against predefined eligibility criteria; 41 sources (36 publications and 5 legal instruments) were included and analyzed thematically. Selection is reported in a PRISMA-style flow diagram. Results: Six connected risk domains were derived from five prespecified themes, namely validation and generalizability; professional competence and automation bias; distributed liability and evidentiary opacity; informed consent and patient autonomy; privacy and cybersecurity of reproductive data; and discrimination, access, and reproductive justice. Generative AI adds risks of hallucination, non-reproducibility, persuasive framing, and undocumented use. Existing law does not eliminate clinician responsibility: accountability is shared across developers, institutions, and professionals, but clinical judgment and documented oversight remain central. In the European Union, Medical Device Regulation and GDPR obligations already apply, whereas AI Act requirements for AI-enabled medical devices apply from August 2028 and the revised Product Liability Directive covers products placed on the market after 9 December 2026; causation and professional fault remain governed by national law. Conclusions: Safe adoption requires more than technical accuracy. abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: To evaluate ChatGPT-generated (GPT-5) simplifications of shoulder MRI reports from the perspectives of orthopedic surgeons and non-healthcare volunteers. Methods: In this single-center retrospective study, 100 de-identified shoulder MRI reports issued between June 2024 and June 2025 were simplified with ChatGPT in February 2026 using a standardized prompt. Between 10 March and 10 April 2026, three orthopedic surgeons independently rated each simplified text against the original report for accuracy, completeness, understandability, and misleading potential on a 5-point Likert scale (higher scores indicating better ratings). In a second arm, 100 adult non-healthcare volunteers each reviewed one simplified report and completed a six-item questionnaire on perceived clarity, comprehensibility, usefulness, and appropriateness. Results: Median expert scores were 5.0 in all domains, and all three raters assigned scores ≥ 4 in 86-98% of reports. Gwet's AC2 ranged from 0.93 to 0.98, whereas Krippendorff's α ranged from -0.02 to 0.05. Among volunteers, agreement ranged from 47% for understanding report terms to 80% for the appropriateness of the text. Health literacy correlated positively with most items (r = 0.329-0.429, p ≤ 0.001), and age correlated negatively with understanding report terms (r = -0.352, p < 0.001). Conclusions: The simplified reports were rated favorably by orthopedic surgeons and were perceived as useful by non-healthcare volunteers. However, the study was limited by its single-center design, the use of a single model and prompt, the absence of a comparison with the original reports in the volunteer arm, and the reliance on self-reported rather than objectively tested comprehension; therefore, it does not demonstrate improved patient comprehension or clinical safety. Such texts should supplement, not replace, the original report and physician consultation.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】从骨科医生和非医疗背景志愿者的角度，评估ChatGPT（GPT-5）生成的肩关节MRI报告简化版本。【方法】在这项单中心回顾性研究中，2026年2月使用标准化提示，用ChatGPT对2024年6月至2025年6月期间出具的100份去标识化肩关节MRI报告进行了简化。2026年3月10日至4月10日期间，三名骨科医生独立将每份简化文本与原始报告对照，按5分Likert量表（分数越高评价越好）就准确性、完整性、易懂性和误导可能性进行评分。在第二个研究组中，100名成年非医疗背景志愿者每人阅读一份简化报告，并完成一份包含六个条目的问卷，内容涉及感知的清晰度、可理解性、实用性和适当性。【结果】各领域专家评分的中位数均为5.0，三名评分者在86%-98%的报告中均给出≥4分。Gwet's AC2为0.93至0.98，而Krippendorff's α为-0.02至0.05。在志愿者中，认同比例从理解报告术语的47%到文本适当性的80%不等。健康素养与大多数条目呈正相关（r = 0.329-0.429，p ≤ 0.001），年龄与理解报告术语呈负相关（r = -0.352，p < 0.001）。【结论】简化后的报告获得骨科医生的良好评价，并被非医疗背景志愿者认为有用。然而，本研究存在局限：为单中心设计，仅使用单一模型和单一提示，志愿者组未与原始报告进行比较，且依赖自我报告而非客观测试的理解程度；因此，本研究并未证明患者理解的改善或临床安全性。此类文本应作为原始报告和医生咨询的补充，而非替代。

abstract: [European radiology experimental] Ultrahigh-resolution (UHR) coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) using a photon-counting detector (PCD) provides excellent spatial resolution but is limited by increased image noise. We evaluated whether deep learning (DL)-based denoising and contrast enhancement can further improve UHR-CCTA image quality. UHR-CCTA scans from 25 patients with coronary artery disease were retrospectively analyzed. Images were reconstructed at 0.2-mm slice thickness without and with quantum iterative reconstruction (QIR, Qoff-Q4), and subsequently processed using a DL tool for denoising and increasing iodine contrast enhancement. Subjective image quality (sharpness, noise, vessel wall delineation, and overall quality) was assessed by three radiologists using a 5-point Likert scale. Objective analysis included signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and coronary wall sharpness. Differences between image sets were analyzed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. DL-based CCTA demonstrated significantly superior subjective image quality across all parameters compared to standard reconstructions, with an overall median image quality ([interquartile interval, IQR]: 4 [3-5] versus 2 [2-3], p < 0.001). SNR and CNR were significantly higher for DL-based CCTA across all QIR levels (all p < 0.001). The highest values were observed for DL-based CCTAQ4 versus UHR-CCTAQ4 (SNR: 258.0 ± 147.5 versus 145.2 ± 50.1; CNR: 25.8 ± 17.1 versus 11.1 ± 4.5; both p < 0.001). Coronary wall sharpness was improved for DL-based CCTA for Q1-4 (all p < 0.027). DL-based denoising and iodine contrast enhancement effectively reduce noise and improve anatomic detail in UHR-CCTA, providing incremental value beyond vendor-specific reconstruction, particularly at high QIR strength levels. Question Deep learning reduces noise and enhances contrast in ultrahigh-resolution coronary CT angiography. Findings Image quality improves beyond standard iterative reconstruction methods, and vessel wall sharpness and diagnostic clarity significantly increase. Relevance statement This study aimed to determine at which levels of vendor-specific iterative reconstruction, DL-based denoising and contrast enhancement perform best in UHR CCTA, providing a foundation for future investigations on how these technical improvements may translate into diagnostic benefits.
zh_abstract: [European radiology experimental] 采用光子计数探测器（PCD）的超高分辨率（UHR）冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）具有出色的空间分辨率，但受限于图像噪声增加。我们评估了基于深度学习（DL）的去噪和对比增强是否可以进一步改善UHR-CCTA的图像质量。回顾性分析了25例冠状动脉疾病患者的UHR-CCTA扫描。图像以0.2 mm层厚重建，分别不使用和使用量子迭代重建（QIR，Qoff-Q4），随后使用DL工具进行去噪并增强碘对比增强。三名放射科医师采用5分Likert量表评估主观图像质量（锐利度、噪声、血管壁显示和整体质量）。客观分析包括信噪比（SNR）、对比噪声比（CNR）和冠状动脉壁锐利度。图像组之间的差异采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验分析。与标准重建相比，基于DL的CCTA在所有参数上的主观图像质量均显著更优，整体图像质量中位数（[四分位间距，IQR]）为：4 [3-5] 对 2 [2-3]，p < 0.001。在所有QIR水平下，基于DL的CCTA的SNR和CNR均显著更高（均p < 0.001）。最高值见于基于DL的CCTAQ4与UHR-CCTAQ4比较（SNR：258.0 ± 147.5 对 145.2 ± 50.1；CNR：25.8 ± 17.1 对 11.1 ± 4.5；均p < 0.001）。在Q1-4下，基于DL的CCTA的冠状动脉壁锐利度均有改善（均p < 0.027）。基于DL的去噪和碘对比增强可有效降低UHR-CCTA的噪声并改善解剖细节，在厂商特定重建之外提供了额外价值，尤其是在高QIR强度水平下。问题 深度学习可降低超高分辨率冠状动脉CT血管造影的噪声并增强对比。发现 图像质量的改善超过标准迭代重建方法，血管壁锐利度和诊断清晰度显著提高。相关性声明 本研究旨在确定在UHR CCTA中，厂商特定迭代重建的哪些水平下基于DL的去噪和对比增强表现最佳，为今后研究这些技术改进如何转化为诊断获益奠定基础。

abstract: [Skeletal radiology] To determine whether deep learning can distinguish younger from older adult women on hand radiographs and to identify candidate anatomical regions for age-group discrimination using explainable artificial intelligence and quantitative cortical measurements. This retrospective, single-center, exploratory study included 2,221 women sampled consecutively within each age group during 2020-2023 (1,134 aged 20-45 and 1,087 aged 55-80 years at radiography). Patients contributed one posteroanterior radiograph and were assigned to mutually exclusive training, validation, or test sets. Five architectures were evaluated on the same 334 held-out test radiographs (171 younger; 163 older), with performance averaged across five random-seed runs. DenseNet121 was selected by descriptive comparison for gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) and ray-based analyses with retraining. Manual cortical measurements of test radiographs yielded metacarpal and proximal phalangeal indices for candidate rays identified by Grad-CAM. DenseNet121 achieved the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, 0.996; 95% CI, 0.992-0.999). Grad-CAM showed prominent activation around the third proximal phalanx, with additional activation in the second and fourth rays. Performance remained high after ray masking; the third-ray-only model achieved the highest mean accuracy among single-ray models. The third proximal phalangeal index had the highest AUC among the six indices (0.956; 95% CI, 0.937-0.976). Grad-CAM, ray-based analyses, and quantitative cortical measurements support the third proximal phalanx as an anatomically interpretable candidate region for age-group discrimination in adult women. Integrating explainable artificial intelligence with quantitative radiographic assessment provides an exploratory workflow for investigating hand skeletal aging, with potential relevance to broader musculoskeletal imaging research.

abstract: Protein flexibility is a key determinant of molecular recognition, catalysis, and regulation, yet remains difficult to characterise at scale. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provide detailed descriptions of time-dependent dynamics but are computationally expensive. Although recent AI-based structure prediction methods have substantially improved access to high-quality static protein structures, they inherently lack information regarding the dynamic fluctuations essential for functional understanding. There is therefore a need for scalable, structure-based computational approaches that can infer intrinsic protein flexibility without explicit dynamical sampling. We present ProtFlap, a graph neural network framework for predicting relative residue-level flexibility directly from static protein structures. ProtFlap represents proteins as residue interaction graphs and integrates empirical atomic energy features extracted from a single energy-minimised snapshot with structural and sequence-derived descriptors. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that the local atomic energy network encoded in a frozen protein structure contains sufficient information to estimate structural flexibility. Trained using atomic mobility labels, quantified via normalised root-mean-square fluctuation (RMSF) derived from short MD simulations, ProtFlap achieves robust and accurate flexibility prediction across diverse protein domains. Feature attribution analysis reveals that van der Waals-related energy terms are the dominant contributors to the prediction.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质柔性是分子识别、催化和调控的关键决定因素，但在大规模上仍难以表征。分子动力学（MD）模拟可对随时间变化的动力学提供详细描述，但计算成本高昂。尽管近期基于人工智能的结构预测方法大大提高了获得高质量静态蛋白质结构的便利性，但它们本质上缺乏对功能理解至关重要的动态涨落信息。因此，需要可扩展的、基于结构的计算方法，在无需显式动力学采样的情况下推断蛋白质的内在柔性。我们提出了 ProtFlap，一个可直接从静态蛋白质结构预测残基水平相对柔性的图神经网络框架。ProtFlap 将蛋白质表示为残基相互作用图，并将从单个能量最小化快照中提取的经验原子能量特征与结构及序列衍生描述符相整合。我们方法的核心假设是：冻结的蛋白质结构中所编码的局部原子能量网络包含足以估计结构柔性的信息。ProtFlap 使用原子迁移率标签（通过由短时 MD 模拟得到的归一化均方根涨落（RMSF）进行量化）进行训练，在多种蛋白质结构域上实现了稳健而准确的柔性预测。特征归因分析显示，与范德华相关的能量项是预测的主要贡献者。

abstract: Abstract: Background: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), a chronic gastrointestinal disorder with two main subtypes, Crohn's Disease (CD) and Ulcerative Colitis (UC), is associated with more aggressive phenotypes and greater diagnostic complexity in pediatric patients. Conventional diagnostic biomarkers, lack sufficient distinguishing power between IBD subtypes. This study aimed to investigate and compare proteomic and metaproteomic profiles of pediatric IBD (PIBD) patients and healthy controls to develop a diagnostic panel capable of accurately diagnose IBD and distinguish its subtypes. Methods: We performed an in-depth evaluation of mucosal luminal interface samples from PIBD patients and healthy individuals, separately analyzing both the human proteome and microbial metaproteome data. The study involved selecting appropriate protein sets, employing feature selection techniques and machine learning across three intestinal regions: the terminal ileum, ascending colon, and descending colon. Results: Notably, panels composed solely of microbial biomarkers outperformed both human-only and combined human-microbial panels, achieving highly accurate results. Furthermore, the ascending colon emerged as the optimal sampling site, a result that aligns with the rich microbial diversity revealed in its taxonomic profile. Conclusions: Using a machine learning-based strategy on combined proteomics and metaproteomics, this study uncovered disease-relevant signaling pathways and delivered taxonomic as well as functional insights into the microbial dysbiosis of PIBD. A diagnostic panel built around microbial proteins (particularly those originating from the ascending colon) emerges as a promising tool for more precise stratification of PIBD subtypes. Larger, prospective studies are now needed to validate these candidate biomarkers and translate them into clinically deployable diagnostic panels. Keywords: Metaproteome, Biomarker, Pediatric Inflammatory bowel disease, Machine learning, Mucosal luminal interface.
zh_abstract: 【背景】炎症性肠病（IBD）是一种慢性胃肠道疾病，有克罗恩病（CD）和溃疡性结肠炎（UC）两种主要亚型，在儿科患者中与更具侵袭性的表型和更高的诊断复杂性相关。传统诊断生物标志物在区分IBD亚型方面能力不足。本研究旨在调查并比较儿童IBD（PIBD）患者与健康对照的蛋白质组和宏蛋白质组谱，以建立能够准确诊断IBD并区分其亚型的诊断组合。【方法】我们对PIBD患者和健康个体的黏膜腔面样本进行了深入评估，分别分析人类蛋白质组和微生物宏蛋白质组数据。研究包括选择合适的蛋白集，并在三个肠段（回肠末端、升结肠和降结肠）采用特征选择技术和机器学习。【结果】值得注意的是，仅由微生物生物标志物组成的组合优于仅含人类蛋白和人类–微生物联合的组合，取得了高度准确的结果。此外，升结肠被确定为最佳采样部位，这一结果与其分类学谱所显示的丰富微生物多样性一致。【结论】本研究采用基于机器学习的策略，对蛋白质组和宏蛋白质组数据进行联合分析，揭示了与疾病相关的信号通路，并提供了PIBD微生物失调的分类学和功能层面的见解。以微生物蛋白（尤其是来源于升结肠者）为核心构建的诊断组合，有望成为更精确分层PIBD亚型的工具。目前需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来验证这些候选生物标志物，并将其转化为可临床应用的诊断组合。关键词：宏蛋白质组；生物标志物；儿童炎症性肠病；机器学习；黏膜腔面。

abstract: The complex network of mechanisms that surround cellular senescence, such as its precise causes and effects, are not entirely understood at present. Senescence occurs when a cell permanently ceases dividing, halts apoptosis, stops performing its normal functions, and begins secreting chemicals that can induce other cells in its environment to also become senescent. Senescent cells are present in both healthy and unhealthy tissue, but their abundance is positively correlated with disease and age. A better understanding of senescence could lead to healthier aging, improved recovery from chemotherapy, or increased lifespan. This study used novel machine learning algorithms - with guaranteed properties of correctness under broad assumptions - to investigate senescence in human liver tissue by analyzing Visium spatial transcriptomics data. This produced data-driven models of the causes and effects of senescence, both locally and from nearby tissue. This report includes an assessment of whether the data meet key requirements for causal analysis, the transcripts identified by causal analyses as causes and effects of senescence marker genes, and pathway analyses of those gene sets.
zh_abstract: 围绕细胞衰老的复杂机制网络（例如其确切的原因和影响）目前尚未被完全理解。衰老发生时，细胞永久停止分裂，停止凋亡，不再执行其正常功能，并开始分泌可诱导其所处环境中其他细胞同样发生衰老的化学物质。衰老细胞存在于健康组织和病变组织中，但其丰度与疾病和年龄呈正相关。更好地理解衰老可能带来更健康的衰老过程、化疗后更好的恢复或寿命的延长。本研究使用在宽泛假设下具有正确性保证的新型机器学习算法，通过分析 Visium 空间转录组学数据来研究人类肝组织中的衰老。由此得到了衰老的原因和影响（包括局部以及来自邻近组织的原因和影响）的数据驱动模型。本报告包括：对数据是否满足因果分析关键要求的评估；因果分析所识别出的、作为衰老标志基因的原因和影响的转录本；以及对这些基因集的通路分析。

abstract: [PeerJ] Artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted ultrasound may improve ultrasound-guided regional nerve blocks, but its effect on novice learning curves is unclear. In this pilot randomized educational study (June-August 2025), inexperienced anesthesiology residents from Shanghai General Hospital were assigned to AI-assisted or conventional training groups. The AI group used an ultrasound system with an AI module and received additional ethics and principles training, while the conventional group received standard training. Image acquisition and interpretation, debriefing time, trainee speaking time, and feedback were evaluated. Twenty-one trainee anesthesiologists were recruited (AI, n = 10; conventional, n = 11). The group-level cumulative sum (CUSUM) analysis identified an estimated turning point (TP) at approximately 12 attempts in the AI group. No comparable TP was identified within the 15-attempt training period in the conventional group. No statistically significant between-group differences were detected in participant-level phase-specific success rates (all P > 0.05). Compared with the conventional group, the AI group reported higher post-training feedback scores for training content (4.7 ± 0.5 vs. 3.6 ± 1.0, P = 0.0076), satisfaction (4.9 ± 0.3 vs. 3.5 ± 0.8, P < 0.0001), and confidence (5.0 ± 0.0 vs. 4.5 ± 0.7, P = 0.0216). Compared with the conventional group, the AI group also had a shorter participant-level mean debriefing time (7.33 ± 0.34 vs. 10.65 ± 0.61 min, P < 0.0001) and a greater proportion of trainee speaking time during debriefing (69.5% (65.70, 70.55) vs. 49.0% (46.70, 49.70), P < 0.0001). AI-assisted ultrasound training might enhance post-training feedback, increase satisfaction and confidence, and reduce debriefing time among inexperienced anesthesiology residents, suggesting its potential utility in the medical education of ultrasound.
zh_abstract: [PeerJ] 人工智能（AI）辅助超声可能改善超声引导下区域神经阻滞，但其对初学者学习曲线的影响尚不明确。在这项试点随机教育研究（2025年6月至8月）中，来自上海市总医院、缺乏经验的麻醉科住院医师被分配至 AI 辅助培训组或常规培训组。AI 组使用带有 AI 模块的超声系统，并接受额外的伦理与原则培训，而常规组接受标准培训。研究评估了图像获取与解读、复盘（debriefing）时间、学员发言时间及反馈。共招募 21 名麻醉科学员（AI 组 n = 10；常规组 n = 11）。组水平累积和（CUSUM）分析显示，AI 组的估计转折点（TP）约在第 12 次操作；而常规组在 15 次操作的培训期内未发现可比的转折点。在参与者水平的各阶段成功率方面，未检测到组间存在统计学显著差异（所有 P > 0.05）。与常规组相比，AI 组在培训后反馈评分中，培训内容（4.7 ± 0.5 vs. 3.6 ± 1.0，P = 0.0076）、满意度（4.9 ± 0.3 vs. 3.5 ± 0.8，P < 0.0001）和信心（5.0 ± 0.0 vs. 4.5 ± 0.7，P = 0.0216）得分更高。与常规组相比，AI 组参与者水平的平均复盘时间更短（7.33 ± 0.34 vs. 10.65 ± 0.61 分钟，P < 0.0001），复盘期间学员发言时间所占比例更高（69.5%（65.70，70.55）vs. 49.0%（46.70，49.70），P < 0.0001）。AI 辅助超声培训可能改善缺乏经验的麻醉科住院医师的培训后反馈，提高其满意度和信心，并缩短复盘时间，提示其在超声医学教育中具有潜在应用价值。
