abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Unplanned readmission within 30 days affects 12-20% of patients after cardiac surgery, largely through complications developing at home. We evaluated the feasibility, acceptability, and adherence of a 30-day post-discharge remote monitoring programme. In a separate retrospective analysis that did not inform patient care, we also assessed how accurately an investigational AI-based classifier triages the programme's wound photographs. Methods: In this prospective single-centre study, 76 of 85 screened patients were monitored for 30 days with twice-daily blood pressure and pulse, daily weight, electrocardiography (ECG), and alternate-day wound photographs, all reviewed daily by a study clinician. Retrospectively, 735 photographs of 88 wounds from 71 patients, labelled by two blinded clinicians, were used to train an ensemble of five convolutional neural networks, tested on a patient-disjoint test set of 147 images from 15 patients. Results: All 76 eligible patients enrolled and 75 (99%) completed the programme, with 82% adherence to the core measurements and an acceptability score of 6.3 (SD 0.5) of 7. Daily review produced 494 teleconsultations, 10 emergency referrals, and 6 admissions (7.9%), and atrial fibrillation was confirmed in 18 episodes in 11 patients. Agreement between the two wound labelling clinicians was κ 0.89. On the test set, the classifier achieved an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.747 (95% CI 0.402-1.000), image-level sensitivity 73.3% (11/15; 95% CI 33.3-100%), precision 73.3%, and wound-level sensitivity 5/6; the one confirmed wound complication in the test set was flagged. Conclusions: Intensive remote monitoring with daily clinician review was feasible after cardiac surgery and was sustained by patients. Daily review identified arrhythmias and wound problems, most of which were managed remotely or in the outpatient clinic. The classifier is a proof of concept for automated triage of such photographs by reproducing clinicians' visual judgment; given the wide confidence intervals, larger multicentre validation is needed.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine]【背景/目的】心脏手术后 12–20% 的患者发生 30 天内非计划再入院，主要是由于在家中出现并发症。我们评估了一项出院后 30 天远程监测方案的可行性、可接受性和依从性。在一项不影响患者诊疗的单独回顾性分析中，我们还评估了一种研究性的基于人工智能的分类器对该方案中伤口照片进行分诊的准确性。【方法】在这项前瞻性单中心研究中，85 名筛查患者中的 76 名接受了 30 天监测，包括每日两次血压和脉搏、每日体重、心电图（ECG）以及隔日伤口照片，所有数据均由一名研究临床医生每日审阅。回顾性地，使用由两名盲法临床医生标注的来自 71 名患者 88 处伤口的 735 张照片训练了由五个卷积神经网络组成的集成模型，并在来自 15 名患者的 147 张图像构成、与训练集患者互不重叠的测试集上进行测试。【结果】76 名符合条件的患者全部入组，75 名（99%）完成了该方案，核心测量的依从率为 82%，可接受性评分为 6.3（SD 0.5）分（满分 7 分）。每日审阅产生了 494 次远程会诊、10 次急诊转诊和 6 次入院（7.9%），并在 11 名患者中确认了 18 次心房颤动发作。两名伤口标注临床医生之间的一致性为 κ 0.89。在测试集上，分类器的精确率-召回率曲线下面积为 0.747（95% CI 0.402–1.000），图像水平敏感性为 73.3%（11/15；95% CI 33.3–100%），精确率为 73.3%，伤口水平敏感性为 5/6；测试集中唯一一例确认的伤口并发症被标记出。【结论】心脏手术后由临床医生每日审阅的强化远程监测是可行的，并且患者能够坚持。每日审阅发现了心律失常和伤口问题，其中大多数通过远程或门诊处理。该分类器是通过再现临床医生视觉判断来对此类照片进行自动分诊的概念验证；鉴于置信区间较宽，需要更大规模的多中心验证。

title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
zh_title: 从AI远程患者监测迈向具身智能体机器人：范围综述
summary: 范围综述认为成熟的智能体式照护尚未出现，多数系统仍由人主导，具身AI多停留在原型和试点阶段，治理与临床整合是关键。
key_points: 多数系统仍为人主导，决策-行动耦合较弱
具身AI基本局限于原型与试点
强调安全、可互操作架构与人类监督
reason: 范围综述属综述类，信息泛化，预印本
abstract: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. Further progress requires safe and interoperable care architectures in which intelligent components operate through clinically validated and accountable workflows. We propose agentic robotics as a future direction for supervised systems embedded in the care ecosystem, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians, caregivers, and patients through auditable workflows that can be interrupted and remain subject to human oversight and explicit AI governance.
zh_abstract: 人工智能赋能的远程患者监测正从被动数据收集向能够解读患者状态、协调照护并在家庭和临床环境中启动行动的能动型（agentic）人工智能系统演进。这项结构化范围综述发现，成熟的能动型照护尚未出现：大多数系统仍以人为主导，而更强的决策-行动耦合和具身人工智能在很大程度上仍局限于原型和试点。医疗机器人使从监测到行动的转变尤为明显，它将人工智能生成的建议和决策转化为言语、动作、提示、身体协助、升级上报和照护协调，使具身性、临床整合、人工监督和治理成为基本的设计要求。进一步的进展需要安全且可互操作的照护架构，使智能组件通过经临床验证且可问责的工作流程运行。我们提出将能动型机器人作为未来方向：在照护生态系统中运行的受监督系统，通过可审计、可中断并持续受人工监督和明确人工智能治理约束的工作流程，将人工智能代理和机器人与临床医生、照护者及患者连接起来。

title: Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
zh_title: 将欧盟AI法案转化为技术要求的参与式研究
summary: 通过32人参与的工作坊，以医疗等场景考察如何把欧盟AI法案义务转化为可衡量的技术要求与合规证据。
key_points: 参与者含研究者、政策制定者和从业者
场景涵盖医疗、招聘和公共交通
发现义务转化、责任监督与证据有效性间的张力
reason: 监管主题的定性研究，医疗仅为场景之一，预印本
abstract: The EU AI Act imposes technical and organizational requirements for high-risk AI systems, but applying these requirements involves contextual choices about what to measure and what evidence supports a compliance claim. We investigate these challenges through a participatory workshop involving 32 researchers, policymakers, and practitioners from different disciplines, using realistic scenarios in healthcare, recruitment, and public transport to examine how regulatory obligations are interpreted, translated into technical requirements, and evaluated in practice. Through a thematic analysis of workshop data, we identify recurring tensions between how regulatory obligations are translated into measurable system properties, how responsibility and human oversight are exercised in practice, and how the validity of compliance evidence is affected by changing operational conditions and system uses. For example, participants highlighted how fairness metrics could conceal discrimination in recruitment, how time pressure and limited information could undermine human oversight in public transport, and how changes in patient populations could invalidate previously established evidence of system performance. Our findings suggest that technical, organizational, and evidentiary challenges are interdependent, and that establishing and maintaining compliance requires attention not only to technical assessments but also to how AI systems are used, governed, and monitored over time. We discuss implications for supporting context-sensitive and ongoing compliance.
zh_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）对高风险人工智能系统提出了技术和组织方面的要求，但落实这些要求需要在衡量什么以及何种证据可支持合规声明方面做出结合具体情境的选择。我们通过一次参与式研讨会来探讨这些挑战，研讨会汇集了来自不同学科的32名研究人员、政策制定者和从业者，采用医疗、招聘和公共交通领域的现实场景，考察监管义务如何被解读、转化为技术要求并在实践中进行评估。通过对研讨会数据的主题分析，我们识别出若干反复出现的矛盾：监管义务如何转化为可衡量的系统属性、责任与人工监督在实践中如何履行，以及合规证据的有效性如何受到运行条件和系统用途变化的影响。例如，参与者指出，公平性指标可能掩盖招聘中的歧视；时间压力和信息有限可能削弱公共交通中的人工监督；患者群体的变化可能使先前确立的系统性能证据失效。我们的研究结果表明，技术、组织和证据方面的挑战相互依存，建立并维持合规不仅需要关注技术评估，还需要关注人工智能系统如何随时间被使用、治理和监测。我们讨论了这些发现对支持具有情境敏感性且持续进行的合规工作的意义。

title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
zh_title: 基于动态形状控制的多视图超声心动图AI合成
summary: 提出形状可控的多视图超声心动图序列合成框架，从动态全心网格提取多视图截面，再经两阶段AI流程生成超声样外观。
key_points: 针对标注数据稀缺，用合成数据缓解
突破现有方法依赖左心室形状或特定视图的限制
保持多视图跨心腔一致性
reason: 预印本合成方法，摘要未见临床验证，增量档
abstract: Although automated methods have improved echocardiographic workflows, progress remains constrained by the need for large, well-annotated datasets. As the development of clinical databases is often limited by ethical and logistical challenges, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising alternative. However, existing approaches commonly rely on left ventricle shape-based supervision or are tailored to specific cardiac views, limiting the generation of additional standard and unconventional imaging planes and the preservation of multi-view consistency across cardiac chambers. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for shape-controlled synthesis of multi-view echocardiographic sequences. First, multi-view cross-sections are extracted from dynamic whole-heart meshes. Ultrasound-like appearance is then introduced through a two-stage AI-based pipeline. In Stage 1, an unpaired GAN-diffusion model translates these cross-sections into realistic echocardiographic frames. As this translation is performed independently at the frame level, Stage 2 employs masked video reconstruction to improve temporal coherence and cardiac motion. Evaluation demonstrated high frame-level realism for both stages, while the integration of Stage 2 substantially improved video-level motion quality and temporal consistency. Overall, the proposed framework enables the generation of realistic multi-view echocardiographic sequences from diverse cardiac models, providing a scalable source of annotated data for dataset augmentation and the development of multi-view cardiac assessment methods.
zh_abstract: 尽管自动化方法已改善超声心动图工作流程，但进展仍受限于对大规模、标注良好的数据集的需求。由于临床数据库的建立常受伦理和后勤方面的挑战所限，合成数据生成已成为一种有前景的替代方案。然而，现有方法通常依赖基于左心室形状的监督，或针对特定心脏切面量身定制，从而限制了更多标准及非常规成像平面的生成，也限制了跨心腔多视角一致性的保持。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种用于形状可控的多视角超声心动图序列合成的新框架。首先，从动态全心网格中提取多视角截面。随后通过基于人工智能的两阶段流程引入类超声外观。在第1阶段，一个非配对的GAN-扩散模型将这些截面转换为逼真的超声心动图帧。由于这一转换是在帧级别独立进行的，第2阶段采用掩码视频重建来改善时间连贯性和心脏运动。评估显示，两个阶段均具有较高的帧级真实感，而第2阶段的整合显著提升了视频级的运动质量和时间一致性。总体而言，所提出的框架能够从多样的心脏模型生成逼真的多视角超声心动图序列，为数据集扩充及多视角心脏评估方法的开发提供了可扩展的带标注数据来源。

title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
zh_title: 基于单通道脑电的可解释睡眠分期
summary: 扩展SleepXAI框架，比较五种XAI方法，并以AASM脑电频段作为参照评估归因保真度，在Sleep-EDF与DREAMT数据集上实验。
key_points: 比较五种可解释方法
以Spearman相关对照AASM频段评估归因
DREAMT按AHI分四个OSA严重度组
reason: 预印本，公开基准数据集，有可解释性评估但无外部临床验证，增量档
abstract: Automated sleep staging has achieved strong bench- mark accuracy; however, clinical adoption remains limited due to a lack of interpretability. In this work, we fill the research gap by extending the SleepXAI sleep staging framework to systematically compare five different XAI methods. Further, attribution fidelity is evaluated using Spearman rank correlation with AASM-defined EEG frequency bands, serving as clinically grounded reference signals. In this paper, we focus on single- channel Electroencephalogram (EEG), which is more amenable to practical clinical deployment compared to full polysomnography setups. Experiments are conducted on the Sleep-EDF benchmark dataset and the DREAMT dataset. In DREAMT, we stratified subjects based on OSA into four Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) severity groups. We observed that the SleepXAI model achieves strong classification performance on both datasets. Among the evaluated methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) consistently achieves the highest mean attribution fidelity across all five sleep stages on Sleep-EDF and across all AHI groups on DREAMT, outperforming all other evaluated methods under the Spearman rank correlation metric. These findings highlight the importance of attribution method selection as a key factor for ensuring reliable and clinically interpretable automated sleep staging systems.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期已取得出色的基准准确率；然而，由于缺乏可解释性，其临床应用仍然有限。在本研究中，我们通过扩展 SleepXAI 睡眠分期框架，系统比较五种不同的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法，以填补这一研究空白。此外，我们以美国睡眠医学会（AASM）定义的脑电图（EEG）频带作为具有临床依据的参考信号，采用 Spearman 等级相关评估归因保真度。本文聚焦于单通道脑电图（EEG），与完整的多导睡眠图配置相比，其更适合实际临床部署。实验在 Sleep-EDF 基准数据集和 DREAMT 数据集上进行。在 DREAMT 中，我们根据阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）将受试者按呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）严重程度分为四组。我们观察到，SleepXAI 模型在两个数据集上均取得了较强的分类性能。在所评估的方法中，积分梯度（Integrated Gradients，IG）在 Sleep-EDF 的全部五个睡眠分期以及 DREAMT 的全部 AHI 分组中，始终获得最高的平均归因保真度，在 Spearman 等级相关指标下优于所有其他被评估方法。这些发现凸显了归因方法的选择是确保自动睡眠分期系统可靠且具有临床可解释性的关键因素。

title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
zh_title: 基于深度学习的交互式脑肿瘤分割界面
summary: 提出默认全自动、可由用户便捷修正的交互式脑肿瘤MRI分割系统，以应对不同MR序列带来的分割失误。
key_points: 默认全自动，支持人工校正
针对不同厂商MR序列差异导致的错误
面向手术切除与放疗的精准分割需求
reason: 预印本，交互式分割方法，评估信息有限，增量档
abstract: Brain tumour segmentation from MR images is an integral part of their treatment, either through surgical resection or radiotherapy. Both applications require a high degree of precision that can be difficult to ensure for all patients due to the high degree of variability in the size, shape, number, and location of these tumours. This leads to difficulties with their automatic segmentation via deep learning, which can display catastrophic segmentation errors when presented with images that differ, even subtly, in terms of the specific MR sequence used, which varies from vendor to vendor. This article presents a deep-learning-based interactive segmentation system that, while being fully automatic by default, has the capability of being easily corrected by human users, allowing them ensure sufficiently high brain tumour segmentation accuracy for all patients. This interface is evaluated both in terms of the accuracy of its automatic approach as well as its usability through a preliminary observational expert user study.
zh_abstract: 从MR图像中分割脑肿瘤是其治疗（无论是手术切除还是放射治疗）中不可或缺的一部分。这两种应用都需要高度的精确性，但由于这些肿瘤在大小、形状、数量和位置上存在高度变异，难以对所有患者都确保这一点。这给通过深度学习进行自动分割带来了困难，当面对在所用特定MR序列上哪怕存在细微差异（不同厂商间各不相同）的图像时，深度学习可能出现灾难性的分割错误。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的交互式分割系统，该系统默认完全自动，同时可由人工用户方便地进行修正，使其能够确保所有患者获得足够高的脑肿瘤分割准确性。通过一项初步的观察性专家用户研究，对该界面的自动方法准确性及其可用性进行了评估。

title: CardioTrace: Motion-Aware Cine Synthesis via Coupled Tracing and Segmentation
zh_title: CardioTrace：耦合追踪与分割的运动感知心脏电影合成
summary: 提出由像素翻译、形变场与分割分支组成的框架，从有限输入合成完整心脏cine MRI序列并显式建模心脏运动。
key_points: 像素翻译分支以残差形式预测帧
流场分支估计形变以提供可解释运动对应
分割分支用于保持解剖合理性
reason: 新颖方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证，增量偏上
abstract: Cardiac cine MRI provides time-resolved visualization of cardiac motion and is essential for evaluating ventricular function and anatomy. In routine clinical acquisition, however, cine sequences are frequently temporally sparse or degraded by arrhythmia, motion, and scan-time constraints, which can hinder reliable quantification and downstream analysis. We present CardioTrace, a motion-aware cine synthesis framework that generates a full cardiac cine sequence from limited input while explicitly modeling and tracing cardiac motion. CardioTrace couples two complementary pathways: a pixel-translation branch that directly predicts cine frames in a residual formulation, and a flow-field branch that estimates time-resolved deformation fields from a reference phase to provide interpretable motion correspondences across frames. To further preserve anatomical plausibility, a segmentation branch supervises clinically meaningful cardiac structures at key phases, and a cross-branch consistency objective encourages the synthesized appearance dynamics to follow the explicit motion guidance, mitigating temporal drift and unrealistic shape transitions over long sequences. The framework also supports prompt-style conditioning to incorporate auxiliary patient or acquisition information, improving robustness across heterogeneous multi-center data. Experiments on public cardiac cine MRI datasets demonstrate that CardioTrace improves perceptual quality and temporal coherence over representative GAN- and diffusion-based baselines, while better preserving ventricular morphology throughout the cardiac cycle. \textit{Our codes are available after review}.
zh_abstract: 心脏电影MRI可对心脏运动进行时间分辨的可视化，对于评估心室功能和解剖结构至关重要。然而，在常规临床采集中，电影序列常常在时间上稀疏，或因心律失常、运动和扫描时间限制而质量下降，这可能妨碍可靠的定量和下游分析。我们提出了CardioTrace，一种运动感知的电影合成框架，它可从有限输入生成完整的心脏电影序列，同时显式地建模并追踪心脏运动。CardioTrace结合了两条互补的通路：一条是像素转换分支，以残差形式直接预测电影帧；另一条是流场分支，估计从参考相位出发的时间分辨形变场，以提供跨帧的可解释运动对应关系。为进一步保持解剖学合理性，分割分支在关键相位对具有临床意义的心脏结构进行监督，同时跨分支一致性目标促使合成的外观动态遵循显式的运动引导，从而减轻长序列中的时间漂移和不真实的形状过渡。该框架还支持提示式条件输入，以纳入辅助的患者或采集信息，提高在异质多中心数据上的稳健性。在公开心脏电影MRI数据集上的实验表明，与具有代表性的基于GAN和扩散模型的基线方法相比，CardioTrace改善了感知质量和时间连贯性，同时在整个心动周期中更好地保持了心室形态。我们的代码将在评审后公开。

title: Vessel2Brain: Edge-Aware Multi-Scale Flow Matching for 3D Brain Image Generation from Vessel Masks
zh_title: Vessel2Brain：由血管掩膜生成3D脑MRI的流匹配方法
summary: 提出边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配框架，仅以血管标签图合成完整3D脑MRI，用于数据增强与仿真。
key_points: 仅以血管标签图为条件
边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配
面向数据增强与神经影像分析
reason: 预印本，新方法但摘要未显示充分对比或临床验证
abstract: Generating realistic 3D brain MRI volumes from sparse anatomical priors is a highly ill-posed yet clinically valuable problem, with important applications in data augmentation, simulation, and downstream neuroimaging analysis. In this work, we investigate the challenging task of synthesising full 3D brain MRI volumes conditioned solely on vascular label maps. While vascular structures provide strong anatomical and topological cues, they occupy only a small fraction of the brain volume and offer no direct information about surrounding tissue appearance. To address this challenge, we propose Vessel2Brain, an edge-aware multi-scale conditional flow matching framework that explicitly incorporates vascular structure information into the generative process. Our approach formulates vessel-guided brain image synthesis as a conditional continuous flow, enabling stable training and flexible generation while preserving structural correspondence. A multi-scale flow matching strategy is introduced to jointly model global anatomical coherence and fine-grained local details, with auxiliary velocity predictions providing additional supervision across spatial resolutions. Furthermore, we design an edge-aware objective that emphasises vascular boundaries during training, encouraging anatomically faithful tissue synthesis around vessel structures. We evaluate Vessel2Brain on two public 3D brain MRI datasets with paired vascular annotations. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, and distributional realism.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) is a common hip disorder in infants. Ultrasound is the primary imaging modality for infants younger than 6 months, but measurements using the Graf and Harcke methods depend on examiner experience. This study aimed to develop and internally validate a key point-based deep learning model for the automated measurement of the Graf α and β angles and femoral head coverage. Methods: A total of 300 standard-plane hip ultrasound images from 165 infants aged 0-6 months were retrospectively collected at a single tertiary center, and reference key points were determined by consensus of pediatric orthopedic surgeons. We developed a dual-branch network, named "DDH-KPNet," which combines a UNet++ convolutional branch and a transformer branch fused with attention modules. Performance was evaluated with fivefold cross-validation at three levels: accuracy of key point localization; intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC); and DDH classification. Results: The experimental results demonstrated that Graf-based classification achieved accuracy = 0.903, sensitivity = 0.81, and specificity = 0.9497 (under 95% conference interval); Harcke classification achieved accuracy = 0.942, sensitivity = 0.888, and specificity = 0.968 (under 95% conference interval); and ICCs for α = 0.832, β = 0.728, and coverage = 0.923. Conclusions: The proposed model showed promising agreement with expert measurements under internal validation. Multicenter external validation and independent diagnostic analysis by different physicians are required before clinical implementation.

abstract: [JACC. Asia] Atrial fibrillation affects approximately 60 million people worldwide, and Europe and the Asia-Pacific region together carry most of that burden. This state-of-the-art review compares the 2 regions across 6 domains: epidemiology and risk factors, lifestyle and comorbidity management, stroke prevention, rhythm control and catheter ablation, digital health and artificial intelligence-electrocardiogram, and health system infrastructure and policy. Practice diverges in all 6. European management follows European Society of Cardiology guidelines, whereas Asia-Pacific region care varies across socioeconomic settings and rests on population-scale evidence, with region-wide guidance so far limited to topic-specific Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) consensus statements until the first APHRS guideline was released in 2026. Anticoagulation gaps have narrowed in both regions, yet disparities in financing, electrophysiology capacity, and digital access persist, and differences within each region rival those between them. Closing these gaps requires region-specific, resource-adapted strategies and mutual adoption of evidence generated in each region.

Asia] 心房颤动影响全球约6000万人，欧洲和亚太地区合计承担了其中大部分负担。这篇前沿综述从6个方面比较了这两个地区：流行病学和危险因素、生活方式和合并症管理、卒中预防、节律控制和导管消融、数字健康和人工智能心电图，以及卫生系统基础设施和政策。两地在这6个方面的实践均存在差异。欧洲的管理遵循欧洲心脏病学会指南，而亚太地区的诊疗在不同社会经济环境中存在差异，并依赖人群规模的证据；在2026年发布首部亚太心律学会（APHRS）指南之前，全区域层面的指导仅限于针对特定主题的APHRS共识声明。两个地区的抗凝治疗差距均已缩小，但在资金投入、电生理能力和数字化可及性方面的差异依然存在，且各地区内部的差异不亚于两地区之间的差异。弥合这些差距需要针对不同地区、适应资源条件的策略，以及相互借鉴各自地区产生的证据。
